title: DSPy Core Data Types
summary: This module defines the fundamental data structures for interacting with Language Models, including request/response formats, streaming events, message roles, and custom types for multimodal and structured data. It provides a standardized way to represent and exchange information within DSPy programs.

nodes.label: LM Request
nodes.title: Language Model Request
nodes.description: Defines the structure for a normalized request sent to a Language Model, including messages, tools, and configuration parameters like temperature and max tokens.

nodes.label: System Message
nodes.title: Create System Message
nodes.description: Helper function to create an LMMessage with the 'system' role, used for providing model-level instructions such as tone, scope, or formatting rules to the LM.

nodes.label: Developer Message
nodes.title: Create Developer Message
nodes.description: Helper function to create an LMMessage with the 'developer' role, used for implementation guidance that is separate from user requests but not model-level.

nodes.label: User Message
nodes.title: Create User Message
nodes.description: Helper function to create an LMMessage with the 'user' role, containing the primary request or data from the user, supporting plain text and multimodal content.

nodes.label: Assistant Message
nodes.title: Create Assistant Message
nodes.description: Helper function to create an LMMessage with the 'assistant' role, representing a previous model response or tool calls within a multi-turn conversation.

nodes.label: Tool Result Message
nodes.title: Create Tool Result Message
nodes.description: Helper function to create an LMMessage with the 'tool' role, used to send the output of a tool execution back to the language model for further processing.

nodes.label: Sync LM Stream
nodes.title: Synchronous LM Stream Handler
nodes.description: Manages synchronous streaming of Language Model events, allowing for incremental processing of responses and providing the final LMResponse result upon completion.

nodes.label: Async LM Stream
nodes.title: Asynchronous LM Stream Handler
nodes.description: Manages asynchronous streaming of Language Model events, enabling non-blocking processing of incremental responses and yielding the final LMResponse result.

nodes.label: LM History Entry
nodes.title: Language Model History Record
nodes.description: A typed record storing a canonical LM request and its corresponding response, providing convenient access to derived fields for historical analysis and debugging.

nodes.label: LM Tool Choice Config
nodes.title: Tool Choice Configuration
nodes.description: Defines controls for native tool-capable models, specifying how tools should be used, including allowed tool names and whether parallel execution is permitted.

nodes.label: LM Reasoning Config
nodes.title: Reasoning Configuration
nodes.description: Configures native reasoning support in Language Models, allowing control over reasoning effort, maximum tokens for reasoning, and summary generation.

nodes.label: LM Cache Config
nodes.title: DSPy Memoization Cache Config
nodes.description: Controls DSPy's internal memoization cache, which skips provider calls entirely when an exact request match is found, improving efficiency.

nodes.label: LM Prompt Cache Config
nodes.title: Provider-side Prompt Cache Config
nodes.description: Configures provider-side prompt/token caching, which can reduce latency and input-token costs by reusing cached prompt prefixes or KV states.

nodes.label: JSON Default Serializer
nodes.title: JSON Serialization Helper
nodes.description: A utility function used for serializing Pydantic models or other complex objects into a JSON-compatible format, typically by calling their model_dump method.

nodes.label: Text Delta
nodes.title: Streamed Text Delta
nodes.description: Represents an incremental text update received during Language Model streaming, containing a portion of the generated text output.

nodes.label: Thinking Delta
nodes.title: Streamed Thinking Delta
nodes.description: Represents an incremental thinking or reasoning update during Language Model streaming, providing insights into the model's internal process.

nodes.label: Tool Call Delta
nodes.title: Streamed Tool Call Delta
nodes.description: Represents an incremental update for a tool call during Language Model streaming, including partial tool name or arguments.

nodes.label: Citation Delta
nodes.title: Streamed Citation Delta
nodes.description: Represents an incremental citation update during Language Model streaming, providing partial citation information as it becomes available.

nodes.label: Image Delta
nodes.title: Streamed Image Delta
nodes.description: Represents an incremental image update during Language Model streaming, typically containing a partial image or metadata.

nodes.label: Audio Delta
nodes.title: Streamed Audio Delta
nodes.description: Represents an incremental audio update during Language Model streaming, providing partial audio data or metadata.

nodes.label: Stream Start Event
nodes.title: LM Stream Start Event
nodes.description: An event signaling the beginning of an LM stream, typically indicating which model is being used for the generation.

nodes.label: Stream Delta Event
nodes.title: LM Stream Delta Event
nodes.description: An event containing an incremental delta update within an LM stream, carrying one of the specific delta types like text, tool call, or citation.

nodes.label: Stream Output End Event
nodes.title: LM Stream Output End Event
nodes.description: An event marking the end of a specific output segment within an LM stream, providing details like the finish reason and whether the output was truncated.

nodes.label: Stream End Event
nodes.title: LM Stream End Event
nodes.description: An event signaling the overall conclusion of an LM stream, providing final usage statistics, cost information, and the complete LMResponse.

nodes.label: Audio Type
nodes.title: Multimodal Audio Data
nodes.description: A custom DSPy type for representing audio data, supporting encoding from URLs, local files, or NumPy-like arrays for use as Language Model input.

nodes.label: Base Custom Type
nodes.title: Base Class for Custom Types
nodes.description: The abstract base class for all DSPy custom types, requiring subclasses to implement a 'format' method to convert their data into a format consumable by LMs.

nodes.label: Citations from Dict List
nodes.title: Create Citations from Dicts
nodes.description: A utility function to convert a list of dictionaries, each representing citation information, into a structured Citations instance for use in LM interactions.

nodes.label: Format Citations
nodes.title: Format Citations for LM
nodes.description: A utility function to format a Citations instance into a list of dictionaries, making it suitable for consumption by Language Models that support citation features.

nodes.label: Validate Citation Input
nodes.title: Validate Citation Input
nodes.description: A utility function to validate and coerce various input formats (e.g., dictionaries, lists of dictionaries) into a standardized Citations instance.

nodes.label: Code Type
nodes.title: Structured Code Data
nodes.description: A custom DSPy type for representing code snippets, useful for tasks involving code generation, analysis, or execution within DSPy programs.

nodes.label: Document Type
nodes.title: Citable Document Data
nodes.description: A custom DSPy type for representing document content with optional title and context, designed to enable citation-aware responses from Language Models.

nodes.label: File Type
nodes.title: Generic File Data
nodes.description: A custom DSPy type for representing generic file data, supporting encoding from local paths, raw bytes, or file IDs for use as Language Model input.

nodes.label: Image Type
nodes.title: Multimodal Image Data
nodes.description: A custom DSPy type for representing image data, supporting various sources like URLs, local files, or PIL image objects for use as Language Model input.

nodes.label: Get File Extension
nodes.title: Extract File Extension
nodes.description: A utility function to extract the file extension from a given file path or URL, used internally for type detection and processing.

nodes.label: Is Image Check
nodes.title: Check if Object is Image
nodes.description: A utility function to determine if a given object represents an image or a valid media file reference, supporting various input formats.

nodes.label: Tool Definition
nodes.title: Define LLM Tool
nodes.description: A class that simplifies the creation of tools for LLM function calling, automatically inferring tool names, descriptions, and argument schemas from Python functions.

nodes.label: Validate Tool Input
nodes.title: Validate Tool Call Input
nodes.description: A utility function to validate and coerce various input formats into a structured representation of tool calls, ensuring compatibility with LM expectations.

groups.label: LM Request & History
groups.title: Language Model Request & History
groups.description: Core data structures for defining LM requests and storing historical interactions.

groups.label: LM Message Builders
groups.title: Language Model Message Constructors
groups.description: Helper functions to construct various types of LM messages (system, user, assistant, tool result) with appropriate roles and content.

groups.label: LM Configuration
groups.title: Language Model Configuration Options
groups.description: Classes defining various configuration options for Language Models, including tool choice, reasoning, and caching mechanisms.

groups.label: LM Streaming Core
groups.title: Language Model Streaming Core
groups.description: Components responsible for managing synchronous and asynchronous streaming of LM responses, including start and end events.

groups.label: LM Stream Text & Tool Deltas
groups.title: Streamed Text & Tool Deltas
groups.description: Specific delta types representing incremental updates for text, thinking processes, and tool calls during LM streaming, bundled with the delta event.

groups.label: LM Stream Media & End Events
groups.title: Streamed Media Deltas & Output End Events
groups.description: Specific delta types for incremental updates of citations, images, and audio during LM streaming, along with events marking the end of output segments.

groups.label: Base & Media Types
groups.title: Base and Multimodal Media Types
groups.description: The foundational class for all custom DSPy types and specific types for handling audio and image data in multimodal LM interactions.

groups.label: Document & Code Types
groups.title: Document, File, and Code Types
groups.description: Custom DSPy types for representing structured documents, generic files, and code snippets, enabling specialized handling in LM programs.

groups.label: Tooling Types & Utilities
groups.title: Tool Definition and Validation
groups.description: Components for defining Language Model tools and utilities for validating tool-related input, facilitating function calling capabilities.

groups.label: Citation Types & Utilities
groups.title: Citation Handling and Formatting
groups.description: Utility functions for creating, formatting, and validating citation data, crucial for models that support source attribution.

groups.label: General Type Utilities
groups.title: General Type Utilities
groups.description: Miscellaneous utility functions for serialization, file extension extraction, and image type checking, supporting various data handling needs.
